findings.summary: An evidence value of a command, a pipe and exit=0 with no result parses with exit=0 taken as the result, so the refusal names a missing result rather than a malformed value
findings.evidence: Reproduced with parse_evidence on the lint command followed by exit=0: it returns the command, 0 and the string exit=0. It fails closed, since the command runs and is refused because exit=0 is not in its output. Message quality only; a follow-up can reject it at parse time
